question: Should OpenClaw accept this mutating Claws apply slice now, including the `--yes` CLI contract and Claw-owned SQLite provenance tables, while the base Claws PR/RFC are still in review?
rationale: The patch is plausible and tested, but it establishes new user-facing mutation and persistent-state contracts that automation should not approve without maintainer product and upgrade intent.

options.title: Hold until base and state direction settle
options.body: Keep this PR draft until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328 and the Claws storage/API direction are accepted, then review the mutating contract.

options.title: Sponsor the mutating slice
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the new `--yes` and SQLite provenance contracts and continue review as a staged feature branch.

options.title: Rescope the storage path
options.body: Ask for the provenance tables to move through the canonical shared-state schema/migration owner path before any merge decision.

recommendation.title: Hold until base and state direction settle
recommendation.body: Keep this PR draft until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101328 and the Claws storage/API direction are accepted, then review the mutating contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily about shared state and shipped CLI/storage contract ownership, where current-main history points to this owner path.
